---
title: Add Runtime Children
description: Add child resources when an experiment discovers structure at runtime.
---

# Add Runtime Children

Templates describe predictable structure. Resource builders can add child
resources when an experiment discovers structure at runtime.

## Add a child resource

Use template name and version:

```python
with namespace.build_resource(resource_id=collection.id) as builder:
    builder.add_child(
        name="Puck01",
        template_name="Puck",
        template_version="1.0",
    )
```

Child resources are persisted as part of the root aggregate and remain
available through the root's `children` dictionary.

## Add a child process step

Runtime child steps record finer detail beneath a template-generated step:

```python
with namespace.build_process_run(process_run_id=run.id) as builder:
    parent = builder.process_run.steps["Transfer"]
    child = parent.generate_child(name="A01 to B01")
    child.parameters.transfer.volume = 20
    child.resources["source"] = source.children["A01"]
    child.resources["destination"] = target.children["B01"]
    builder.add_child_step(child)

recorded = builder.process_run.steps["Transfer"]["A01 to B01"]
```

Children use their parent's exact step template and start with template-default
parameters, rather than the parent's recorded values. Roles inherit run-level
resource assignments through the template's slot bindings. An explicit role
assignment must select the assigned resource or one of its descendants.

`run.steps` contains template-generated steps only. Each step's `children`
dictionary contains its runtime children; `step[name]` is shorthand for
`step.children[name]`. Child names are unique within their parent. Children
cannot have further child steps.

To correct an existing child, edit a detached run model and submit it:

```python
with namespace.build_process_run(process_run_id=run.id) as builder:
    model = builder.get_model()
    model.steps["Transfer"]["A01 to B01"].parameters.transfer.volume = 25
    builder.set_model(model)
```

Parameter values, units, value metadata, and resource-role replacements can be
edited. Deletion, reparenting, template changes, and clearing role overrides are
not supported. Recording a transfer does not change liquid balances or resource
properties automatically.

## Lifecycle behavior

Mutable resources and runs accept children in place. Adding children to an
active resource or finalized run creates a mutable copy by default. To correct
the original, open its builder with `in_place=True`; its ID and status remain
unchanged and its revision increments. Archived originals cannot be edited.
Child additions and owner content changes are committed together; a failed
addition rolls back the content changes in that submission.
